blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate finance committee head Sen. JV Ejercito on Monday endorsed the P7.2-trillion 2027 General Appropriations Bill (GAB) for plenary approval. Ejercito previously said the finance panel cut P97 billion worth of noncompliant projects from the Department of Public Works and Highways budget approved in the House of Representatives’ version of the GAB. Of the P97 billion, P68.8 billion was reallocated to foreign-assisted projects, including the Metro Manila Subway Project, the North-South Commuter Railway, the Cavite-Bataan bridge, and the Laguna Lakeshore Highway.
